history.empty: This repository has no commits yet.
diff.binary: Binary file. There's no text diff to show.
diff.pickFile: Pick a changed file to see its diff.
diff.readOnly: Past commits are read-only. Edit files in Changes.
welcome.title: Welcome to GitLore
welcome.intro: A local workspace for understanding how a codebase changed and why. The demo project TaskFlow is open so you can try everything right away.
welcome.step1: Pick a commit on the left to see exactly what changed.
welcome.step2: Select code in a diff, right-click, and choose Ask GitLore About Selection.
welcome.step3: Ask anything about the history in the assistant on the right.
changes.none: No changes yet. Open a file and edit it to start.
changes.busy: A {op} is in progress in this repository. Finish it in Git first.
assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.slowNote: The first words can take 10–20 seconds on a CPU.
assistant.empty: Ask how and why this code changed. Answers cite the commits they come from; click a citation to open it.
assistant.suggest1: Why did the login switch to JWT tokens?
assistant.suggest2: Which bugs were fixed, and how?
assistant.suggest3: Why was the CSV export reverted?
assistant.noModel: The assistant needs its model: a one-time 1.1 GB download that then runs offline on your CPU.
menu.explainQuestion: Explain this code: what does it do, and why was it changed?
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageNote: Changes the interface and the language the assistant answers in.
settings.modelMissing: Not downloaded yet ({size} GB, one time).
settings.customNote: Any GGUF chat model llama.cpp supports. Larger models answer better but slower.
settings.removeProjectNote: Removing a project only forgets it here. The folder on disk is never touched.
settings.commitCountNote: Newest first. Indexing runs at roughly 25–30 commits per second.
settings.private: Runs locally on your CPU. Nothing leaves this computer.
confirm.removeModel.title: Remove Model?
confirm.removeModel.body: This deletes {file} ({size} GB). You can download it again later.
confirm.removeProject.title: Remove Project?
confirm.removeProject.body: GitLore forgets “{name}” and its chats. The folder on disk is not touched.
confirm.deleteChat.title: Delete Chat?
confirm.deleteChat.body: This deletes “{title}” and all its messages.
confirm.rebuild.title: Rebuild Index?
confirm.rebuild.body: This deletes the index of {n} commits and indexes the repository again.
confirm.discard.title: Discard Unsaved Changes?
confirm.discard.body: {path} has edits that aren't saved yet.
common.offline: GitLore isn't running anymore. Start it again with start.bat (Windows) or start.sh (macOS / Linux).
